    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:49:16.360
    | text      = And I think that when he brings this up

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:03.159

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:06.199

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:12.760

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:13.760
    | text      = And I get asked this question a lot

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:15.880

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:20.880

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:23.800

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:26.679
    | text      = And to that, I would say we're in power right now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:30.039
    | text      = We, the Republicans, the Trump movement are in power.

}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:33.840
    | text      = Republicans still as of right now control the House

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:36.920
    | text      = and the Senate.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:37.920
    | text      = Allegedly in the first term, they engineered it

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:40.639

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = the Supreme Court.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:44.159
    | text      = So without a doubt, we have all the cards,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:46.880
    | text      = we have all the power.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:48.760
    | text      = And I think that when that is the case, especially,

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = maybe it's a different story when Biden was in charge,
}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:54.360

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:56.840
    | text      = when he was the president.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:58.199

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:51:02.760
    | text      = to put the heat on Trump and to light a fire under them
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:06.199

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:09.079
    | text      = because we don't have that much time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:10.840
    | text      = See, I think this marks a big division

    | timestamp = 00:51:13.559

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:15.559
    | text      = Alex, his shit is so based on victimhood and aggrievement
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:20.000
    | text      = that like he can't really acknowledge
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:22.519
    | text      = that they have all the power.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:23.760
    | text      = Yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:24.679
    | text      = Everything is coming up Republican right now.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:27.239
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:28.079
    | text      = And I think Nick can, I think he can acknowledge that

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = and say it's masturbatory to fuck around
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:34.199
    | text      = and like complain about AOC all day or whatever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:37.559
    | text      = Like that's not impacting and moving the ball forward.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:51:42.039
    | text      = We have this small window of time

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:43.880
    | text      = where we have all the power.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:49.159

    | text      = Yeah.

    | text      = Otherwise, we're just biding our time

{{TranscriptBlock

}}
